difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y weakly etale with Y a normal scheme, the lemma concludes X is normal — the normality-going-up law of the weakly etale toolkit. The retained proof is written: the henselian normality dictionary (More on Algebra, lemma henselization-normal: a local scheme is normal exactly when all strict henselizations of its local rings are normal domains) reduces the claim to the stalk-level statement; the chapter's lemma weakly-etale-strictly-henselian-local-rings (weakly etale maps induce isomorphisms on strict henselizations — the comparison proved in the same section) then transfers normality of the strict henselization from Y-side to X-side point by point. Retained author proof at lines 19156-19162.
